scope: Cumulative virtual registration and bulk permanent deletion with shared-runtime Windows updater architecture.
changes: Retains transform-only virtual registration for long RTC360 registration chains
Retains multi-scan single-pass permanent point compaction
Shared Windows runtime migration using same-volume directory move and junction
